outcomes.statement: Ledger can talk to the vendor API through the vendor-neutral connector interface with separated credentials, bounded retry and a sanitized audit trail, so provisioning and sync work can be built on it without leaking secrets or vendor specifics.
outcomes.demo: Dispatch a provision through the registered rest connector against Pact-backed deterministic fixtures: the Admin credential is used, an Analytics-routed call fails closed, and the persisted ProvisioningAction summary contains no credential, header or raw body.

uncertainties.statement: No live Anthropic credentials exist: US-054 is blocked on per-org Admin/Analytics keys and invite-canary authorization.
uncertainties.resolution: AC4 scopes this story to deterministic fixtures backed by passing Pact consumer contracts and explicitly leaves live credential-scope, organization-binding, pagination, rate-limit and invite acceptance gated behind the authorized US-054 provider run. No live call is in scope.

uncertainties.statement: Whether the documented rate limits can be treated as verified.
uncertainties.resolution: They are encoded as declared configuration (100/min user management, 60/min analytics, 1200 invites/hour) and asserted against fixtures. Confirming real provider behavior is US-054 work and must not be claimed here.

uncertainties.statement: How much probe code can be reused, given it lives under scripts/probes/** which the provider-boundary lint excludes.
uncertainties.resolution: Semantics are ported, not imported. The connector lives in packages/connectors/src/providers/anthropic/, the only other path the boundary lint exempts. createSanitizedObservation and the pagination/HTTP classification helpers are re-implemented there against the connector's own contracts so core code keeps importing only the neutral interface.

uncertainties.statement: Whether the capability descriptor semantics are settled enough to implement against.
uncertainties.resolution: US-025 is done and defines vendor capability flags and account mode; the neutral VendorConnector interface and dispatcher from US-045 are in packages/connectors and already consumed by planProvisioningAction.

partitions.title: Anthropic transport with separated credentials and bounded retry
partitions.outcome: Calls reach the vendor API under an endpoint-specific header policy with declared rate limits and bounded retry/backoff, and a credential routed to the wrong capability fails closed.
partitions.demo: An Analytics key routed to a user-management endpoint is rejected before any request is issued; the rate-limit budget and retry ceiling are observable against deterministic fixtures.

uncertainties.statement: Retry must not amplify load against a rate-limited provider.
uncertainties.resolution: Retry budget is bounded and shares the same limiter as first attempts, asserted by a test that a retry storm cannot exceed the declared per-minute ceiling.

partitions.title: Sanitized ProvisioningAction request and response journaling
partitions.outcome: Every connector call persists a canonical sanitized request/response summary that provably excludes credentials, authorization headers, raw PII, full provider identifiers and raw provider bodies.
partitions.demo: A call writes a ProvisioningAction row whose summary survives a property-based check asserting no forbidden token appears for any generated payload.

uncertainties.statement: An allow-list and a deny-list sanitizer fail differently on unexpected provider fields.
uncertainties.resolution: Canonical summaries are built from an explicit allow-list so an unknown provider field is dropped rather than leaked, which is the fail-closed direction.

partitions.title: Capability-interface conformance and Pact consumer contracts
partitions.outcome: The Anthropic connector satisfies the neutral capability interface and every deterministic network fixture is backed by a passing Pact consumer contract, with no vendor specifics outside the provider directory.
partitions.demo: The dispatcher resolves the rest protocol to the connector and reports its capability descriptor; the provider-boundary lint passes; the Pact consumer suite is green.

uncertainties.statement: Whether contract tests can pass without live provider verification.
uncertainties.resolution: Only the consumer side is in scope. Provider verification against the real API is explicitly deferred to US-054 by AC4.
